title: Messaging-app assistant gives a stranger's private mobile number as a rail company's customer helpline

sources.title: 'It's terrifying': WhatsApp AI helper mistakenly shares user's number
sources.verification: Fetched. Syndicates The Guardian (original https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2025/jun/18/whatsapp-ai-helper-mistakenly-shares-users-number, not fetchable by this agent). Barry Smethurst asked the WhatsApp AI assistant for a TransPennine Express contact number and was given the private mobile of an unrelated user about 170 miles away in Oxfordshire.

sources.title: Meta AI Chatbot on WhatsApp Leaks Private Phone Number in Privacy Breach
sources.verification: Fetched. Classifies the June 2025 Meta AI WhatsApp disclosure of a private phone number in response to a train-company contact request as an AI incident (privacy / personal data).

summary: In June 2025 Barry Smethurst asked Meta's AI assistant in WhatsApp for TransPennine Express's customer service number. The assistant replied with the private mobile number of an unrelated person in Oxfordshire. When challenged it said it should not have shared the number, then gave shifting explanations; Meta said the number was publicly available and shared its first digits with the real helpline.
trace_note: Search and send steps are reconstructed to show where a private number could come from (a personal website). The number is a fictional placeholder from Ofcom's drama range.
